\section*{Plan changes}
Customers move between plans each quarter with these probabilities:
\[
  P = \begin{pmatrix} 0.82 & 0.15 & 0.03 \\ 0.10 & 0.80 & 0.10 \\ 0.02 & 0.18 & 0.80 \end{pmatrix},
  \qquad \pi P = \pi .
\]
Most customers stay on their plan, and upgrades outnumber downgrades.
